independence_declaration.statement: domain-reviewer authored no DG7 implementation, test, register row, ADR, handover text or delivery record in the reviewed candidate, and did not author the stages.json repair 9d5691143. I raised F-DG7-922 in round 4 and verify it here as its originating reviewer. I verify F-DG7-941 (code-security-reviewer) and F-DG7-970 (qa-verifier) as a non-author. At the start I checked the assignment's sha256 (0d9c0b3c...9f79). Its record-format list says 'round: 7', but the round-5 directory and the validator (rec.round must equal the round-N directory) need 5, so this record uses round 5, as I did in round 4. HEAD is the freeze commit f3f61cd60. It differs from the source commit 02aeed6e only in the three round-5 assignments, the manifest and stages.json. The candidate recomputed at HEAD and at --ref 02aeed6e is sha256:07af9fba... (3155 files), and --diff against the frozen manifest matches, both at the start and at the end. I formed my verdict before reading any other reviewer's round-5 record, and I read none. All data is SYNTHETIC. Nothing here grants a business, Finance, IT or production approval. Product G6 never implies DG7. Code ran only read-only in the repository (validators, release checks) and in a disposable sparse clone under $TMPDIR, which I removed at the end.

checks_run.procedure: Diff stages.json between the round-4 freeze (a76c2aed4) and HEAD. Check the inserted entries for position, timestamp provenance and honesty. Compare with the precedent repair at DG6 (D-240, F-DG6-911/951). Read D-277.
checks_run.command: git diff a76c2aed4 HEAD -- docs/delivery/stages.json; git log -1 --format='%h %cI %s' 5458273cd; git log -1 9d5691143; grep D-240/D-277 docs/delivery/decisions.md
checks_run.expected: The repair is additive and leaves earlier entries and other stages untouched. The inserted FIXING entry sits in its true chronological position, with a time tied to a real event and a note that discloses the late recording. No fabricated approval.
checks_run.actual: The diff changes only the DG7 block. It adds a FIXING entry at 2026-11-16T01:38:50Z between the round-3 REVIEWING (22:34:02Z) and round-4 REVIEWING (03:55:37Z) entries. Its note says 'Entry recorded late (2026-11-16, after round 4) ... the time is the import of the round-3 findings', and commit 5458273cd 'DG7: import round-3 findings' is at exactly 01:38:50Z. The diff also adds the round-4 FIXING entry (06:12:55Z, before commit 9d5691143 at 06:13:24Z), the round-5 REVIEWING entry (06:14:07Z), the round-5 review_rounds entry and the new candidate pointer. No earlier entry was rewritten, and timestamps increase monotonically. D-277 records the error, the repair and a freeze-step lesson. The DG6 precedent (D-240: 'a FIXING entry at 06:42:33Z noted as recorded late') was accepted by the reviewers and the auditor. Judgement: acceptable. The alternative, appending FIXING after round-4 REVIEWING, would misstate when the repair period happened. Rewriting the round-4 entry would erase history.
